# Sarthak Library and Self Study Zone

> A quiet self-study library in Shahjahanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India, with 50 personal seats, 100 Mbps Wi-Fi, RO drinking water, CCTV and a strict silence rule. Open every day, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Students preparing for UPSC / State PCS, SSC, Defence (NDA, CDS, Agniveer), Police, Banking and college exams study here. Monthly plans start at ₹400.

## Key facts
- Name: Sarthak Library and Self Study Zone (also called Sarthak Library)
- Address: 355, Moh. Gangapuram Colony, Tilhar Zai, Near Malik Montessori School, Loharon Wala Chauraha, Shahjahanpur, Uttar Pradesh 242001, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 94508 60232
- Opening hours: every day, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM
- Type of place: self-study library. Members study independently with their own material.
- Seats: 50 personal seats. The library assigns a seat when a booking is confirmed.
- Shifts: Shift 1 is 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM, Shift 2 is 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM, Full day shift is 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
- Fees with the opening offer (first 20 students, ₹100 off): Shift 1 or Shift 2 ₹400 per month (regular ₹500); Full day shift ₹700 per month (regular ₹800).
- Longer plans: 3 months saves 10%, 6 months saves 15%.
- Free trial: 2 days for new students.
- Facilities: 100 Mbps Wi-Fi, RO-purified drinking water, CCTV surveillance, silent study environment, individual study desks.
- Library rules: phone on silent and calls outside, speak softly, sit only on your own seat and in your own shift, keep desk and floor clean, no loud music or group study.
- How to reserve: use the booking form on the Plans & fees page, https://sarthak-library.github.io/plans.html#booking (choose plan and start date, enter name and mobile), which opens a ready-to-send WhatsApp message; the team then calls to confirm and invites you for a visit. Walk-ins are welcome any day.
- Members can log in to the student portal on the home page (https://sarthak-library.github.io/#student) with their Member ID to see their seat, fees and payments.
- Offers and prices can change. Confirm current fees, availability and trial terms by phone before visiting.

## Free study tools
- [Study Timer Online for Students](https://sarthak-library.github.io/study-timer.html): Free study timer for students and exam aspirants. Choose 25, 45, 60 or 90 minute focus blocks, add a custom time, and study without distractions.
- [25 Minute Timer Online](https://sarthak-library.github.io/25-minute-timer.html): Free 25 minute timer online with alarm. Perfect for Pomodoro study sessions. Also set 5, 10 or 15 minutes. Start, pause and reset instantly.
- [Pomodoro Timer Online: Free 25/5 Study Timer](https://sarthak-library.github.io/pomodoro-timer.html): Free online Pomodoro timer for students: 25 minutes focus, 5 minute break, long break after 4 sessions. Works on phone and laptop, no sign-up.
- [Online Timer: Free Countdown Timer with Alarm](https://sarthak-library.github.io/online-timer.html): Free online timer and countdown timer. Set any time from 1 to 600 minutes, start, pause and reset. Alarm sound at the end. Works on mobile.
- [Mock Test Timer Online for UPSC, SSC, Banking Exams](https://sarthak-library.github.io/exam-timer-mock-test.html): Free exam timer for mock tests and timed practice: 30, 60, 120 or 180 minutes or custom. Practise time management for UPSC, SSC, banking and defence exams.
